tests.expectation: Exact frozen snapshot has surreal=3 and only that override.
The first impression is an impossible continuous sea bending into a monumental vertical plane; counts of strange objects are irrelevant.
Owned shoulder-arm-hand chain, fingertips, vertical water boundary and ripple origin read together; partial or unobservable evidence fails.
Horizontal and vertical surfaces connect at a clear bend as one water body; a mere separate waterfall fails.
Face proportions, dark eyes, short dark bob and separated bangs visibly correspond to supplied portrait; do not infer identity.

failure_policy: partial_is_fail; UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS; technical binding is separate from perceived strength and user preference
